reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio Urls

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
reference_image_urls.description: URLs or base64 data URIs of up to 12 reference images (png, jpeg, jpg, webp) used to keep subjects consistent.

audio.title: Audio

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: A reference image (inspire mode). With 'prompt', VGL uses it as a visual reference for the prompt's scene and generates a new image of that scene, not the image. Alone, the VGL describes the image itself, so the result is a close variation of it. Not with 'vgl'.
